site_number: Land at Chiswick Roundabout Junction Gunnersbry Avenue
description: Erection of a landmark office building (B1 use) comprising of retail showroom at ground floor, with 8 office floors above and basement car park providing 6,606sqm total floorspace and incorporating 4 media advertising screens with LED shroud.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered P00A, P01A, P02A, P04A, P05A, P06A, P07A, P08A, P09A, P10A, P11A, P12A, P13A, P14A, P15A, P16A, P17A, P18A, Received 21 April 2011, P40-00, P41-00, Received 2 September 2011, 
P03B, P19B, Received 27 June 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a Construction Management Plan and Construction Logistics Plan. 
These plans should provide details on the likely highway and traffic impact to the TLRN.

The Construction Management Plan should include a scheme to cover the following matters: 
i.	any external illumination of the site during construction; 
ii.	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and 
iii.	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties. 

The scheme as approved by the Local Planning Authority shall be fully implemented, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of development a detailed lighting management plan (LMP) shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA.  No development shall be carried out until the LMP has been approved.  

The LMP shall cover the:
i) LED shroud;
ii) four advertisement screens; and
iii)  other external lighting (if any).

 The LMP shall assess the impact of the lighting on:
a) highway safety; and 
b)  the amenity of:
i) residents
ii) business users
iii) public open spaces
iv) character of the area
and provide for such impacts to be mitigated. 

The LMP shall cover (without limitation):

i) lux levels/lighting intensities
ii) timing for frequency of changes of moving displays (if any) 
iii) colours
iv) hours of operation
v) the inter-operation of the shroud, four advertisement screens and other external lighting (if any) 
vi) the maintenance and operation of the shroud, four advertisement screens and other external lighting (if any)

The shroud, four advertisement screens and other external lighting (if any) shall not be operated other than in accordance with the approved LMP for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of all the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces (including the external office surfaces) of the development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme). 

All hard and soft landscape works, including landscape maintenance as approved, unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority. 

All soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details within the first planting season after the occupation of any building and retained thereafter. 

If within a period of five years from the date of planting any tree or specimen shrub or green area that tree or specimen shrub or green area or any tree or specimen shrub or green area planted in replacement for it is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree or specimen shrub of the same specifies and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written approval to any variation.

Condition : 8 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development for its permitted use.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 9 - Prior to any occupation of the development a scheme for the storage and collection of waste and materials to be recycled including a timetable for implementation shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the approved scheme shall then be managed as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 10 - The roof garden approved shall only be used ancillary to the office use, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - Prior to occupation details shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a Cleaning and Maintenance Plan for the exterior surfaces of the building (including both the shroud and office building). 
The Cleaning and Maintenance Plan shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 12 - No additional floorspace above 6,606m? shall be formed within the building hereby permitted by means of horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 13 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 14 - No development shall take place until a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to, around the building has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall be implemented before the building is occupied unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 15 - The retail showroom hereby approved shall have a maximum gross internal floor area of 199m2, as shown on drawing number P03B Rev 00 (Received 27 June 2011), and may be used for any use within Class A1 with the exception of a supermarket or convenience store.

In respect of any of the above Class A1 use hereby approved, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the use shall not be changed to a supermarket or convenience store without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 16 - Prior to the occupation of the building a total of 49 cycle parking spaces shall be provided in the building (as shown on Drawing P02A-REV00) and made available for use, and thereafter retained and made available to the occupiers of the building.

Condition : 17 - Prior to the occupation of the building the space for vehicle parking, turning, loading and unloading shall be provided in accordance with the parking layout, as marked out in accordance with the approved drawings (numbered P02A, Received 21 April 2011).  This area shall, thereafter, be kept available for parking and turning of motor cars and goods vehicles at all times.

This shall include 12 electric vehicle charging points.

Condition : 18 - Prior to the occupation of the building, the vehicle accesses shall have been constructed in accordance with the details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA, and in compliance with the requirements of Transport for London.

Condition : 20 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a Delivery and Servicing Plan for the uses hereby approved. 
The Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 21 - No part of the building shall be occupied until full details of the CCHP scheme proposed in the Energy Statement (Re: 5015-RES1104MP02 dated April 2011) are submitted to and approved in writing by the Hounslow Council unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Informative: These details should include i) installation contract showing the manufacturer, model and electrical and thermal output of selected CCHP engine; ii) written evidence of the engine's compatibility with blends of biodiesel from used cooking oil; iii) a copy of the biodiesel supply contract, demonstrating that the biodiesel meets standard EN14214 (or such standard as is deemed by the Local Planning Authority as replaying this) and that it will be sourced from cooking oil and will constitute a minimum of 80% of the fuel blend; iv) photographs of the installed CHP plant; v) copy of a 12 month warranty and comprehensive maintenance contract.

Condition : 22 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, for a sustainable construction scheme, to comply with the "essential" standards for materials in the Mayor's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.
